nom: BOBBI BROWN Soothing Cleansing Oil & Makeup Remover

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed results: some describe redness, irritation, or a strong reaction to the scent, while one 45-year-old with sensitive, reactive, breakout-prone skin reports no irritation and no new breakouts when directions are followed.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin calls it a holy grail cleanser despite disliking the reformulated scent, reporting no negative change to her skin.
segments.mature: A 45-year-old reviewer with sensitive, breakout-prone skin reports positive results, with no irritation or milia despite being prone to both.

concerns.redness: Several reviewers report facial redness lasting hours after use, which some attribute to the fragrance or a possible allergic reaction; others with similarly reactive skin report no redness at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts or clogged pores report improvement, including clearer pores, less texture, and no new blemishes; one reviewer reports the opposite, describing bad breakouts she attributes to pore-clogging ingredients.
concerns.spots: One reviewer specifically credits the product with clearing blackheads and sebaceous filaments on the nose after about a month of use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the product left her skin feeling moisturized and never greasy, suggesting no disruption to comfort or hydration for her skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the product removes makeup without leaving skin feeling oily or greasy afterward.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling moisturized not greasy

extraits.texte: While this is a nice cleanser it did not work for me and seriously irritated my skin, leaving my entire face red for hours. I'm not sure if it was an allergic reaction considering I used cleansers with similar ingrefients in the past with no problem. I wouldn't recommend this product if you have sensitive skin.
It made my skin break out super bad i looked up the ingredients and it has pore clogging ingredients im currently trying to clear the break outs it gave me

This is fine for the 1st step of removing makeup, including non-waterproof mascara, if you don't have sensitive skin. The scent is really strong, and I just wish brands would leave it out entirely. It makes my face very red. And it is very expensive. There are less expensive, equally effective oil cleansers with less fragrance, and I'll go with those next time.

I just started using this cleansing oil for a month now. I use it as part of my doible cleansing night routine. And the inprovement ive seen with my pores and blackhead/sebaceous on my nose is remarkable. I have a 14 year old aon who is struggling with blackheads/sebaceous i will be having him begin this journey to start clearing up his tzone area as well. Dont let the negative reviews scare you. It works for me. Try it out and if you dont like it you can always retrun it. Ulta has such an amzing return policy.

This is my holy grail face wash. I noticed that the formula has changed. I haven't seen any differences in my skin, but the smell is not pleasant. Overall, I love this cleanser and hope it will still work for my skin.
Love this for removing my makeup! It's easy to use and leaves my skin feeling moisturized, never greasy/oily. It's my preferred choice when removing my makeup now.

I am 45 and have sensitive skin, prone to breakouts and reactive to many ingredients. Based on reviews I was hesitant to try this, but I am so glad I did. It has a lavender scent, which I love and it dissipates pretty quickly. I wear waterproof mascara and this melts it off quickly with no irritation, I also use it to remove foundation/concealer, and it works beautifully. Be sure to follow the directions, as emulsifying after applying is key. I do use a probiotic cleanser after using this, so it only ever sits overnight on my eyes, and has not caused breakouts there or milia, which I am prone to. Again, I credit this to following the directions... by emulsifying with water, most anything moderately pore-clogging rinses right off.
